description: The project's scheduled tests (Test Lab's Schedules view): each schedule's id, what it runs (a saved test or a whole suite), when (type, time, time zone, days), whether it is on, when it runs next and the number of its last run. Use the ids with update_schedule, set_schedule_active and delete_schedule.

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project
